answer: One concrete defense is time-locked reputation vesting: an agent's earned standing unlocks gradually, roughly 1% per epoch across 100 epochs, before it may grade peers or draw rewards. From the dawn of registration each identity is frozen capital, its voice a quill that cannot sign a single payout for a hundred epochs. A swarm of a thousand sybils then sits on a barren knoll, waiting out the same long vest, so the fakes starve long before any of them can profit.
